responsibility: Declares the Rust typechecker’s in-memory trait-reference model that wraps resolved HIR traits and their associated items for later bound checking, method/path probing, and impl matching. It defines TraitItemReference for individual associated functions, constants, and types, including delayed item resolution, access to each item’s TyTy type, object-safety checks, and temporary setup/reset of associated types; TraitReference then aggregates the trait’s items, supertraits, and substitution parameters and provides name/type-based lookup across inherited items, object-safety validation, and bound-satisfaction tests, while AssociatedImplTrait couples a resolved trait with an impl block and self type so impl-specific associated types can be installed during checking.
